entry_points.text: Background per node thread sets immunity and freezer support then alternates sleep and balance preserving order; boot init starts one thread per memory node and registers vm controls.
Node device writes forward text to proactive reclaim for that node reporting length or error; refresh folds current CPU diffs and optionally maintains pagesets reporting activity.
Frag iteration seeks by node offset over online nodes; reporting prints per zone free counts by order plus per migratetype free and block summaries.
Pagetype overview skips memoryless nodes and shows order plus three sections; early mem setup wires queue hotplug shepherd proc sysctls; debug init creates extfrag dir and files.

exports.text: Global reclaim frees a requested count with movable unmap writeback swap and reports freed pages; rescue returns stable flagged folios; proactive files follow node lifetime.
Event and locality reporting sums online CPU counters with stable set handling, folds deltas clearing them, totals one NUMA event per node, derives pressure limits and refreshes thresholds.
Node and page resolved counters use small per CPU deltas folded on threshold crossing; public forms delegate generically or mask local interrupts.
Deferred stats offer current CPU quieting and workqueue flushing; early init creates the reclaim capable queue and wires hotplug shepherd proc and sysctls.
Working set exposes a global shadow reclaim list, a folio activation hook aging history, and a node updater keeping shadow only nodes discoverable.

hazards.text: Boosted passes skip writeback swap and failure counts and abort without progress; sleep wakes allocators first; rescue skips folios losing tracking.
Stale per CPU batches can hide minimum breaches so limits stay conservative; free displays cap entries to avoid lockups; unsynchronized order counters are display only.
Snapshot alloc can fail with memory error; unexpected negatives only warn; shadow isolation retries on contention and warns on page bearing nodes.
Fixed policies are node reclaim priority 4, min slab ratio 5, NUMA enable 1, pressure 1..125, remote idle 3 after activity.
ABI has swappiness 0644 0..200, zone reclaim mode 0644, vm prefix, interval refresh NUMA controls, four proc views with pagetypeinfo restricted, extfrag files, swappiness tags.

invariants.text: Aging prefers generational mode while switching continues else needs anon permission plus low inactive anon to rotate; target uses max of high watermark and cluster floor; sentinel keeps prior ceiling.
Presleep wakes allocator waiters, sleeps hopeless nodes for direct reclaim and balanced nodes after clearing node plus cgroup congestion and writeback; marking applies uniformly to managed zones.
Event sums start zeroed and accumulate all counters on all online CPUs with wrapper protection; invalidation clears per CPU deltas and atomics across populated zones plus globals.
Pressure clamps to 1..125; crossing leaves half threshold opposite bias; refresh exchanges nonzero zone and node deltas into globals.
Zone qualified names exist only for enabled kinds with normal movable always present; census strides by pageblock ignoring holes and foreign pages; mixed needs page owner tracking.
First populated zone carries node counters once; zones show free boost watermarks span reserves counters; global snapshot covers all families; refresh warns on bad negatives.
Pending is any nonzero diff byte; quiet folds locally only when running with pending work; online enables work, removal disables, dead clears node presence when empty.
Per order indices print after headers with full frag when no free pages else unsuitable share; activation skips uncharged then ages under RCU; shadow target is excess over bound.

locks.text: Locality toggle holds a dedicated mutex across sampling handling flip and invalidation; event sums hold CPU set read protection.
Boost decrements from a start snapshot under per zone spinlock with IRQs saved; unevictable scan holds at most one vector lock at a time.
Node updates disable nested preemption; walker holds each zone IRQ lock only around callbacks; free scan drops the lock once per order around scheduling.
Shadow membership needs radix tree lock with emptiness stable under page cache lock; isolation starts under list lock then retries other locks before validation.

state_machines.text: Balancing is boost aware with suppressed writeback swap while boosted, throttled wakeups on progress, failures only for empty unboosted passes, plus settlement and snapshots at end.
Sleep uses timed wait then indefinite sleep each gated by balance checks with compaction wakeups isolation reset relaxed thresholds asleep tightened awake and quick wake counts.
Locality toggle flips a global branch only on changing writes, enabling collection or disabling plus invalidating counters; unchanged or failed writes leave state.
Per CPU work folds diffs and requeues only on activity; shepherd guards hotplug, skips isolated CPUs, queues idle workers with diffs, always requeues; remote pagesets arm wait exempt or drain.

structs.text: Node has id zones counts waiters requests failures flags; zone has lock flags watermarks boost drift stats thresholds deltas atomics; control has mask order ceiling priority permissions progress state.
Contig info groups free pages blocks and suitable blocks; one string table names all stat items with per zone expansion; global zone node locality arrays are cache aligned and macro sized.
Six seq tables share node iteration with varying show callbacks; frag pagetype zone unusable extfrag reuse start next stop while vmstat uses snapshot iteration.
Shadow encoding reserves one low bit; eviction shifts derive from word radix node memcg widths plus anon swap; masks cover low bits; buckets split file anon.
Two system atomic longs track total memmap pages and the boot allocated subset for diagnostics and sizing.
